title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that actually quantifies trust in navigation systems using real-world, multi-agent scenarios.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential—it ensures NavTrust isn’t just theoretical. Without standardized metrics, trust remains subjective and unmeasurable.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses LiDAR and vision fusion to validate agent behavior, offering a concrete, replicable framework for trust assessment.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking reveals flaws in NavTrust’s assumptions—like over-reliance on static environments, which don’t reflect real-world chaos.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Trust without benchmarks is just a buzzword—NavTrust needs real, dynamic testing to prove its value.
